result.reason: The added subsection appropriately and narrowly extends the licences to Corio’s Affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, while preserving Corio’s responsibility for compliance. However, Section 2.2’s fully paid-up licence is only stated to be perpetual, not irrevocable, so the preferred position is not fully achieved. Successor transfer also cannot be confirmed without the operative text of Section 14.1; the margin comment cannot substitute for that language. The amendment is otherwise limited and preserves unrelated commercial intent.
